interpretations: For each telescope and its observatory’s weather profile, calculate the average modulation index and average phase shift of matching signals. Compute one baseline as the unweighted mean of all telescope/weather groups’ average modulation indexes, and keep only groups above it. For each weather profile, return the weather profile, the unweighted mean of the kept groups’ average modulation indexes, the unweighted mean of their average phase shifts, and the unweighted mean of their modulation index averages minus the baseline, without rounding.
queries:
WITH telescope_weather AS (
    SELECT
        t.telescregistry,
        o.weathprofile,
        AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_modindex,
        AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshift
    FROM telescopes AS t
    JOIN observatories AS o
        ON o.observstation = t.observstation
    JOIN signals AS s
        ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
    GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile
),
baseline AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex
    FROM telescope_weather
)
SELECT
    tw.weathprofile,
    AVG(tw.avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex,
    AVG(tw.avg_phaseshift) AS avg_phaseshift,
    AVG(tw.avg_modindex - b.avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex_above_baseline
FROM telescope_weather AS tw
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE tw.avg_modindex > b.avg_modindex
GROUP BY tw.weathprofile
